script.why: daytime; haze gathering over the harbor at the end

scenes.name: Walk from the temple around the harbor
scenes.what: The POET wanders alone from the new temple along the harbor to the cafe.
lines: with every pulsing beat after walking alone
scenes.camera: long lens lateral track along the promenade, water and boats between camera and POET
scenes.position: harbor promenade between the temple and the cafe
scenes.here: the promenade from the temple round the harbour
scenes.block: long-lens lateral, water and boats between camera and him (23)

scenes.name: The corner cafe table
scenes.what: He sits at a corner table and observes couples at other tables, wanting to be noticed.
lines: I want you to notice me in a corner cafe
at the Harbor of the Heavens, wandering in thought
scenes.camera: static medium on the POET at the corner table, couples soft in the foreground; eyeline cuts to the tables
scenes.position: corner table by the window inside the cafe
scenes.block: static medium; couples soft in the foreground

scenes.name: Distances, younger selves, praying elders
scenes.what: Cutaways: silhouettes on opposite shores, ghost children behind glass, an old couple praying together at church.
lines: with the distances we couldn't avoid
our younger selves watching and dreaming
while our elders clutch their pearls
scenes.camera: reflections in the cafe window double his face with the ghost children; quiet wide in a church pew for the elders
scenes.position: window glass of the cafe; an old harbor church (cutaway)
scenes.here: the café glass; a harbour church
scenes.block: reflections double his face with the ghost children

scenes.name: Victory-less seasons (inner montage)
scenes.what: From his seat: a lone traveler, burning diary, love letters blown away, dusty trophy cases, flowers frozen in ice.
lines: I've journeyed beyond any place you can conceivably be
life has burned all of my love stories
victory-less seasons for a man that wanted just one win
scenes.camera: push in on his still face, then match-cuts into the montage
scenes.block: push on his still face; match-cuts into the montage

scenes.name: Harvesting the poppies
scenes.what: Fields of scarlet poppies and purple blossoms are harvested and become the POET's power.
lines: than the scarlet poppies and purple blossoms
scenes.camera: aerial over flower fields; light flowing into his chest in a close-up
scenes.here: the Night Garden Field by day, harvested
scenes.block: aerial over poppies; light into his chest

scenes.name: From a distant window
scenes.what: Still at the cafe watching couples; hope that someone will notice him and meet his eyes.
lines: Yet from a distant window, beautiful and calm
hope tells me you'll see me
capture my eyes as you refocus yours
scenes.camera: through-the-glass shot from outside the cafe; rack focus from reflection to his eyes; iris close-up
scenes.position: the cafe window seen from the harbor
scenes.here: the café window from the harbour
scenes.block: through-the-glass from outside; rack focus to his eyes (24)

scenes.name: Stands and walks the harbor
scenes.what: He leaves the cafe and walks around the harbor as haze starts to gather on the water.
lines: all the fatigue of wandering alone in thought
won't prevent me from sharing a smile worth the promise of my heart
scenes.camera: follow from behind along the waterline; widen as haze rises off the water
scenes.here: the harbour edge and piers, the haze rising
scenes.block: follow from behind along the waterline; widen as the haze comes off the water (80, 65)

districts.name: Mirror Thread Bay

districts.hour: daytime (13), then the haze; at night the bioluminescence
districts.weather: calm, bright; haze gathering off the water
districts.sound: the harbour slapping the piles, gulls, a café's cups, the sleep-dam pumping
districts.camera: low over water; reflections first, subject second; through glass from the harbour side
districts.light_tech: daylight on water; at night the drowned gardens' own light (bioluminescent), fishermen's lamps in the cathedral
districts.arch: promenades on the old quay, pier decks, drowned atria with glowing floors, the sleep-dam's concrete wall with its graffiti, footbridges over the canals
districts.language: the line at +4 m is everywhere and in the drowned rooms it is underwater; benches face the water; tide boards at every pier

facts: an elevated path with a lit edge in orange fog (84, 85)
a figure at the rail of a platform over nothing (81)
it ends over the harbour, where the haze takes him (14)
its line across the plan; it should follow the expressway ring

heroes.name: The Drowned Atrium
heroes.brief: a tower lobby that stayed flooded after the Fall: water to +4 m, floor glowing beneath, trees in planters rising into the light, a walkway across
beats: the walk from the temple to the café passes through it
facts: lit floors under still water, trees, glass walls (53–56)
kept, not drained: 'the bay keeps it'
